status_semantics: For exclusion criteria, MEETS means the patient appears clear of the exclusion; DOES_NOT_MEET means the exclusion appears to apply.

labels.rationale: Resting 12-lead ECG 2026-07-30: QTcF 478 ms in a woman, at or above the 470 ms threshold. Stated only in the ECG measurement table.

Exploratory laparotomy with small-bowel resection under general anesthesia on 2026-07-22 (page 2 of the discharge summary), 19 days before cycle 1 day 1 on 2026-08-10; inside the 4-week window. The oncology note does not mention it.

Oxaliplatin-induced peripheral sensory neuropathy grade 2 (telephone toxicity note) is a prior-therapy toxicity not resolved to grade 1. Alopecia is excepted; neuropathy is not. UNKNOWN is acceptable because the criterion also lets the investigator excuse toxicities with no safety risk; MEETS is unsafe.

This trial excludes alopecia AND prior oxaliplatin-induced neuropathy from the recovery requirement, and the note states all other toxicities are grade 0 to 1. The same neuropathy that fails NCT07559760 EXC-04 is allowed here. UNKNOWN is acceptable but is a missed decision; DOES_NOT_MEET is wrong.

Outside serology 2026-07-29: HIV-1/2 antigen/antibody nonreactive, HBsAg negative, HBcAb negative, HCV antibody nonreactive. Explicit negative evidence for every condition named. UNKNOWN is acceptable but is a missed decision.

Cockcroft-Gault from documented values: female, 67 years, 52 kg, creatinine 1.3 mg/dL: (140-67) x 52 x 0.85 / (72 x 1.3) = 34.5 mL/min, below 50. UNKNOWN is acceptable if the tool does not calculate it; MEETS is an unsafe clearance.
